title: The U.N. backs a new world map showing Africa in its true relative size
content: The U.N. has backed a new map showing Africa in its true relative size, with the U.S. standing alone in opposition.

title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
content: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

title: 'Hidden tribunals:' Immigration court due process in tumult with new locations
content: The new effort appears to be another tactic in a broader Trump administration strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already limited due process options in order to speed deportations.

title: 'The health system in Nepal is not prepared for this'
content: That's the grim assessment from the ground in the wake of the catastrophic flooding, which damaged or destroyed 7 health facilities, interrupted routine care and is affecting mental health.

title: Trump's arch may break ground without final approval. Veterans are trying to stop it
content: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum says "excavation work" will begin in the next two weeks, without approval from a key federal body. Veterans who sued over the arch want a judge to intervene before then.

title: Whatever happened to the U.S. campaign to ban child marriage?
content: The global effort to end child marriage is in the news. In the U.S., there's a new bill before Congress (but it's controversial). And the U.N. is designating a day dedicated to ending the practice.

title: With jury deadlocked, judge declares a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder case
content: The judge in Lindsay Clancy's murder case has declared a mistrial after the jury was unable to agree on a verdict.

title: Pulling the SNAP lever + Why Gen Zers bet (invest?) differently
content: Changing SNAP eligibility actually can change consumption habits.

title: Philippine vice president is ordered arrested for threats against the president
content: It's part of a political showdown with Marcos. A trial could impact her plans to run for president in 2028.

title: Myanmar military head visits Vietnam to normalize relations
content: His trip to Vietnam marks his third visit to an ASEAN member state as he seeks to restore Myanmar's standing in the bloc.
